# notewise docs map for LLM retrieval

Project: notewise
Primary entry: /index
Description: Convert YouTube videos and playlists into AI-powered study notes from your terminal.

## Purpose
Fast retrieval index for assistants answering notewise usage, operations, and contribution questions.
Prefer links here over guessing command flags, defaults, or output behavior.

## Behavioral truths (avoid common mistakes)

- Standard video output: top-level in OUTPUT_DIR — <sanitized_title>.md
- Quiz export: top-level in OUTPUT_DIR — <sanitized_title>_quiz.md
- Transcript exports: top-level in OUTPUT_DIR — <sanitized_title>_transcript.txt or .json
- Per-video folders: ONLY created for chapter-aware long videos (duration > 1 hour with chapter data)
- Config file: ~/.notewise/config.env — override location with NOTEWISE_HOME
- Priority: code defaults < config.env < environment variables < CLI flags
- cache --clear removes database records only — does NOT delete generated note files

For implementation-level confirmation:
- src/notewise/cli/app.py
- src/notewise/pipeline/_execution.py
- src/notewise/pipeline/_artifacts.py
